purpose: Records surviving lines authored by an identity whose rights are UNRESOLVED, where the surviving text carries no expression and therefore cannot support an authorship claim against it. Verified mechanically by scripts/ip/deminimis-adjudication.mjs against the real file content on every run.
limits: This is not a finding that the identity's rights are resolved. The identity stays UNRESOLVED in docs/ip/contributor-rights-register.json.
This is not a finding that the line was removed. The line remains in the product and in Git history.
The only claim is that the quoted text is below the threshold at which authorship could be asserted over it. Any change to the quoted content invalidates the entry automatically.
The verifier independently refuses any line carrying executable tokens, or any comment long enough to express something, whatever this file says.

adjudications.rationale: Commit 1b5a84b07, message 'ci: trigger identity RLS exact-head acceptance', appended a blank line and a label comment after the script's final functional statement. The commit exists to change the file's hash so an exact-head CI workflow would re-run; it adds no behaviour and describes nothing the script does not already state. These are the only two lines in the repository still attributed to this identity.
